Scope: Python packaging, preparation, build pins and local installation/update fixtures. No native compilation, launcher execution, real Windows/AD operation, shipped pack or neutral configuration edit.

Findings.Description: Missing cfg creation followed linked wad or template parent; creation/pack guard now rejects linked components, while an already existing cfg remains untouched.
Directory or ZIP copy failure could leave incomplete output. Only the owned partial output is cleaned after an exception; existing/concurrent outputs and broken links remain untouched.
ZIP writer accepted a target inside its payload and followed linked entries. Both are rejected.
Native runtime_header bypassed closed-list/path validation used by the manifest. It now shares runtime_files/safe_file and refuses linked generated headers.
Malformed recovery Id/Backup/hash values caused uncaught type errors. Exact required value types now produce validation errors without altering the fence.
Old update manifests accepted logs, configuration backups and developer paths. Both new and old manifests now share the runtime path policy.
Production staging followed links inside development tools. Included tool links/junctions are rejected before staging is created.
A two-pack request could publish PROD before a failed DEV step. Both directories and ZIPs are prepared and verified before output publication; failures clean only the owned output.

InstallerRuntime: PowerShell 7.4.20 on macOS, real Install-Pesto.ps1 against disposable local fixture files; no application execution. All6cases executed, no skip.
InitialGlobalRun: 329 cases:323 passed,6 installer cases skipped because PESTO_TEST_PWSH was not set. The dedicated installer run closes those6cases; final full rerun will use the explicit variable.
Limits: File exception handling tested; no claim of atomic multi-file publication under machine power loss.
Windows junction detection uses the existing filesystem detector; these link cases run on macOS.
Final full Python run awaits root rebuilding the launcher and manifest after concurrent runtime edits.
